label: Serious — anaphylaxis after amoxicillin (complete, valid)
text: SYNTHETIC FAKE REPORT — no real patient. Patient SK, a 58-year-old female, was prescribed Amoxicillin 500 mg three times daily starting on 2026-11-08 for a chest infection. On 2026-11-10 she developed severe anaphylaxis with difficulty breathing and a widespread rash, and was hospitalised overnight for observation. The report was submitted by Dr. Priya Nair, GP, on 2026-11-11. No other medicines were reported.
